registered_domain_reachability: The three ordering comparisons in `obs_lo,obs_hi = (back,lay) if back<=lay else (lay,back)` (L118), `if hi < obs_lo` (L119), `if lo > obs_hi` (L121). Model bounds satisfy lo <= hi and, once sorted, obs_lo <= obs_hi.
exact_reachable_state_evidence: (L118 `back<=lay`->`back<lay`) differ only at back==lay, where both orderings yield the identical tuple (back,lay)==(lay,back); the misordering `!=`/`is not` siblings were KILLED by test_interval_violation_reversed_back_lay_orders_observed. (L119 `hi<obs_lo`->`hi<=obs_lo`) differ only at hi==obs_lo; there the branch would return obs_lo-hi==0.0, and the fall-through also returns 0.0 (the second branch lo>obs_hi is unreachable because lo<=hi==obs_lo<=obs_hi), so the output is 0.0 either way. (L121 `lo>obs_hi`->`lo>=obs_hi`) differ only at lo==obs_hi; there the branch returns obs_hi-lo==0.0 and the fall-through also returns 0.0, so identical. All three are output-invariant order-boundary no-ops; the arithmetic sibling (Sub->Mod on L120) was KILLED by test_interval_violation_far_below_distinguishes_sub_from_mod.
